name: STS 2: Philosophy of Science and Technology
description: This course provides an introduction to philosophical inquiries into science and technology. The spectrum of posi-tions considered ranges from the classic ("positivist") philosophy of science to the historical and social turn (Fleck, Kuhn, the "Strong Programme") to classic philosophy of technology to the currently dominant focus on scientific practice and technoscience. Questions to be examined include the following: What are the key characteristics of scientific theory and practice? What are the conditions of their emergence and success? What techniques and technologies are involved in scientific discovery? Conversely, what influence do scientific discoveries have on technological innovation? What modes of knowledge are involved on either side?
prerequisites: Good English; basic skills in critical thinking
